description: [$0.04/sec at provider cost] Restyle a scene's footage, keeping its motion. style must be one of the presets (anime, comic, watercolor, oil_painting, sketch, cinematic, vintage, neon). A free-text style is refused, because free text over the user's footage could change who appears in it; pick the closest preset instead. Mints a NEW asset - the original is never destroyed.
